properties.name: taxonomy_id
properties.description: Surrogate key of the taxonomy.

properties.name: taxonomy_code
properties.description: Stable code of the taxonomy, for example POSITION_TYPE. Unique.

properties.name: name
properties.description: Display name of the taxonomy.

properties.name: description
properties.description: What the taxonomy classifies and how it is used.

properties.name: source_standard
properties.description: External standard the taxonomy follows, if any (for example SOC, NAICS, ISO 3166).

properties.name: owner_role
properties.description: Role accountable for the taxonomy's content.

properties.name: status
properties.description: Whether the taxonomy is in use (for example ACTIVE, RETIRED).

collections.description: One enterprise taxonomy, such as Position Type, Geography, Industry Classification or Chart of Accounts. Its nodes and versions are data in TaxonomyNode and TaxonomyVersion.

properties.name: taxonomy_version_id
properties.description: Surrogate key of the version.

properties.name: taxonomy_id
properties.description: The taxonomy this version belongs to.

properties.name: version_seq
properties.description: Sequence number of the version within its taxonomy (1, 2, 3...). Unique with taxonomy_id.

properties.name: version_label
properties.description: Display label of the version, for example 2026.1.

properties.name: status
properties.description: Publication state of the version.
properties.valueDefinitions:
DRAFT: Being edited; at most one per taxonomy.
PUBLISHED: Released; never changes.
RETIRED: No longer the current version.

properties.name: effective_from
properties.description: Business date from which the version applies.

properties.name: effective_to
properties.description: Business date until which the version applies (open if empty).

properties.name: published_at
properties.description: When the version was published.

properties.name: published_by
properties.description: Who published the version.

properties.name: based_on_version_id
properties.description: The version this one was started from.

properties.name: change_summary
properties.description: What changed in this version.

collections.description: A named release of a taxonomy: DRAFT, PUBLISHED or RETIRED. Versions are the clock all taxonomy history is measured against. A taxonomy has at most one DRAFT version. Published versions never change; a correction is a new version.

properties.name: node_version_id
properties.description: Surrogate key of this version row of the node.

properties.name: node_key
properties.description: Durable identity of the node across all versions.

properties.name: taxonomy_id
properties.description: The taxonomy this node belongs to.

properties.name: node_code
properties.description: Stable code of the node within its taxonomy; used in key_path.

properties.name: node_label
properties.description: Display label of the node; used in label_path.

properties.name: description
properties.description: Meaning of the node.

properties.name: parent_node_key
properties.description: node_key of the parent node; empty for a root. The only hierarchy attribute that is edited.

properties.name: depth
properties.description: Distance from the root (root = 0). Derived from parent_node_key.

properties.name: sort_order
properties.description: Display order among siblings.

properties.name: is_leaf
properties.description: True when the node has no children in this version.

properties.name: key_path
properties.description: Materialised path of node codes from the root, for example TECH.ENG.SWE. Derived.

properties.name: label_path
properties.description: Materialised path of labels from the root, for example Technical > Engineering > Software. Derived.

properties.name: from_version_seq
properties.description: First taxonomy version (version_seq) in which this row applies.

properties.name: to_version_seq
properties.description: Taxonomy version from which this row no longer applies (open if empty).

properties.name: valid_from
properties.description: When this row became valid (set on publication).

properties.name: valid_to
properties.description: When this row stopped being valid.

properties.name: is_current
properties.description: True for the row valid in the current published version.

properties.name: change_type
properties.description: Why this row was created.
properties.valueDefinitions:
CREATE: New node.
RENAME: Label changed; descendants get PATH_CASCADE rows.
MOVE: Parent changed; closure rows of the subtree are closed and reopened.
UPDATE: Other attribute changed.
RETIRE: Node closed; children are moved or retired first.
PATH_CASCADE: Path changed because an ancestor was moved or renamed.

collections.description: One version row of a taxonomy node (adjacency list, materialised path and SCD Type 2). node_key is the node's durable identity across all versions. Only parent_node_key is edited; depth, key_path and label_path are derived from it in the same transaction, together with the TaxonomyClosure rows. Nodes are retired, never deleted. A move into the node's own subtree is refused.

properties.name: ancestor_node_key
properties.description: node_key of the ancestor.

properties.name: descendant_node_key
properties.description: node_key of the descendant.

properties.name: from_version_seq
properties.description: First taxonomy version in which this pair applies.

properties.name: taxonomy_id
properties.description: The taxonomy both nodes belong to.

properties.name: depth
properties.description: Number of levels between ancestor and descendant (0 = the node itself).

properties.name: to_version_seq
properties.description: Taxonomy version from which this pair no longer applies (open if empty).

properties.name: valid_from
properties.description: When this pair became valid.

properties.name: valid_to
properties.description: When this pair stopped being valid.

properties.name: is_current
properties.description: True for pairs valid in the current published version.

collections.description: Every ancestor-descendant pair of nodes with its depth (closure table, SCD Type 2). Derived from TaxonomyNode.parent_node_key in the same transaction as each change, never edited directly. Rows join on node_key, not on the node version row. A scheduled check rebuilds the closure from the adjacency list and compares; any difference is a defect.

properties.name: transaction_hierarchy_id
properties.description: Surrogate key of the classification event.

properties.name: taxonomy_id
properties.description: The taxonomy used.

properties.name: transaction_entity
properties.description: Name of the EDM entity of the classified record, for example Position.

properties.name: transaction_id
properties.description: entity_id of the classified record.

properties.name: classification_role
properties.description: Purpose of this classification.
properties.valueDefinitions:
PRIMARY: The record's main classification in this taxonomy.
SECONDARY: An additional classification (for a record that belongs in two branches).
REPORTING: A classification used only for reporting.

properties.name: node_key
properties.description: Durable identity of the node the record was classified under.

properties.name: node_version_id
properties.description: The node version row in force at classification.

properties.name: taxonomy_version_id
properties.description: The taxonomy version in force at classification.

properties.name: key_path_snapshot
properties.description: key_path of the node at classification (as-was).

properties.name: label_path_snapshot
properties.description: label_path of the node at classification (as-was).

properties.name: effective_from
properties.description: Business date from which the classification applies.

properties.name: recorded_at
properties.description: When the classification was recorded.

properties.name: recorded_by
properties.description: Who or what recorded the classification.

properties.name: source_system
properties.description: System that supplied the classification.

properties.name: supersedes_id
properties.description: transaction_hierarchy_id of the row this one replaces.

properties.name: reason_code
properties.description: Why the record was classified or reclassified.

collections.description: Immutable history of which taxonomy node a business record was classified under, with the node version and both paths as they stood then. Append-only: no update or delete; a reclassification is a new row that supersedes the previous one. The classified record is named by transaction_entity and transaction_id, with no relationship; allowed entity names are listed in config/edm-rules.yaml. A "transaction" here is any classified business record, not a financial transaction.

buckets.name: CommonTaxonomy
buckets.description: The generic, versioned taxonomy model (D11). Every enterprise taxonomy is data in these five entities. It combines an adjacency list (the source of truth), a closure table, materialised paths and SCD Type 2 bounded by named versions.
